plain_text:
Frank Lovejoy appears in 151 recordings across 25 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive in 1971. The credits here include performer and writer.

In this archive, you will hear Frank Lovejoy most often in Night Beat, Columbia Workshop, The Whistler, The Blue Beetle, Escape, Boston Blackie, Suspense, and Screen Directors Playhouse.

Characters credited here include Randy Stone, Dan Garrett, and John J. Malone.
